tips.text: Run Uranus Survival for the Drekar Troopers; several players say they spawn heavily there.
Expect a normal Sealab farm; nobody calls the 0.50% blueprint drop painful.
Use any Sealab mission, including Defense, where Troopers start around wave 10 on the low-level node and wave 20 on the high-level one.
Try Interception on Uranus for faster spawns.
